title: RR Geometry Shoulder Search (v2.4 Specification)
changes: For ②/⑥ locate the most recent confirmed HA-close valley, then take the calendar day immediately before that valley as shoulder.
For ③/④ locate the most recent confirmed HA-close peak, then take the calendar day immediately before that peak as shoulder.
Use stair geometry only (no same-color, nearest-higher/lower, or biggest-drop shortcuts). The evolving current day can confirm yesterday’s pivot.
Preserve ① direct short and ⑤ direct long, all ten RR stages and user-adjusted 1.50/1.70 thresholds.
Preserve persistent R2 risk/RR settings, drawings, charts, 7D bounds and 10-second updates without new requests.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite exactly the four MultiAssetLiquidityRadar files in GitHub Pages.
Cloudflare Worker / R2 migration NOT required; user settings and drawings are unchanged.
